title: Chinese Mathematical Classics: Original LaTeX and Multilingual Translation Drafts
description:
Public corpus page for Chinese mathematical classics in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record exposes reader PDFs directly and keeps source material in filtered ZIP artifacts.

Status at a glance. [#########-] English, modern Chinese, Chinese-original, and Arabic working-reader surfaces are present for the main corpus; [######----] working drafts for checking and continuation; [----------] not a proofed critical edition.

2026-06-04 Arabic update. This version adds five reader-facing Arabic translation-draft PDFs covering the currently staged Chinese mathematical classics: Jiuzhang Suanshu / Nine Chapters vols. 1-9, Li Ye's Ceyuan Haijing vols. 1-12, Qin Jiushao's Shuxue Jiuzhang fascicles 1-9, Sunzi Suanjing, and Yang Hui's Xiangjie Jiuzhang parts 1-3. The accompanying 80-01 ZIP preserves 17 individual TeX/PDF files and the local check note. Two older ambiguous/partial Arabic entries are superseded on the current file surface by these combined readers; older versions remain available through Zenodo version history.

Provenance. This page is derived from the consolidated non-European mathematics release. The source ZIPs contain filtered TeX/source artifacts for this corpus; the complete as-received raw provenance archive is preserved on the consolidated project record. The workflow collects source scans and reference texts, converts them into TeX drafts, checks them into readable PDFs, and publishes source artifacts for inspection and correction.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Corpus-level public page with reader PDFs first and filtered TeX/source artifacts later. The 2026-06-04 update adds five combined Arabic working-translation readers plus the lower-level Arabic TeX/PDF completion package. Local checks verified PDF openability, page counts, and absence of obvious process labels in the combined Arabic readers; translation accuracy remains a working-draft matter. Metadata-only refresh 2026-07-02: added GitHub issue/pull-request correction route; no files were changed by this metadata refresh.
